content:
maya: Quick proposal: introduce a "proportional quota exchange" that lets customers convert unused monthly Pro-tier credits into Starter credits at a fixed ratio. Idea is to reduce churn when customers mistrack usage but avoid giving full-dollar refunds. Thoughts?

carlos: Interesting. Need a clear revenue impact model. If conversion = 1:1 we lose margin. What's the proposed ratio? :thinking:

maya: Thinking 0.6 Starter credits per unused Pro credit (i.e., exchange_rate=0.6). Defaults to monthly, auto-opt-in for accounts with <10% usage last 3 months. Early sketch:
```
exchange_rate = 0.6
min_commit = 10000  # only for committed contracts if > min_commit, admin opt-in
window = 30  # days, monthly conversion runs on billing day
```

jia: Sales like anything that reduces friction for renewals. Two asks: 1) allow manual one-off exchanges during renewal windows, 2) a toggle in quotes for enterprise customers.

tom: Dev concerns: we need per-customer historical usage, retention of converted credits, and a ledger entry for audit. Implementation complexity: moderate. KV model change + billing job. Estimate: 2 sprint work + 1 for QA. Also need UI flag in Console.

rachel: Legal flags: contract language needs to clarify conversion is final, non-refundable, and subject to a cap. Also we must ensure customers can't game it (e.g., spin down usage to convert at month-end). Propose anti-abuse rule: account must have steady usage pattern (no >90% drop in last week) to qualify.

carlos: From revenue ops: run a 90-day trial with 5% of renewals to gather loss/gain metrics. Key metric: net revenue retention delta and downgrade rate. Also require a kill-switch.

maya: Agreed. Proposed launch criteria: 
- Feature gated behind toggle 
- Metrics dashboard: conversion_count, converted_value_usd, delta_NRR, abuse_flag_count 
- Legal sign-off on TOS language 
- Sales training doc + quote toggle
- Ops rollback plan

ops-bot: deploy-bot: staging deployment scheduled for 2024-06-18 03:00 UTC (flag: quota-exchange).

jia: For quoting, we need an optional line-item: "Converted Starter Credits (from Pro)" with value and audit link. Also want a tooltip copy: "Credits converted automatically each billing cycle if account qualifies."

tom: Implementation notes for engineers: store conversions as a separate ledger row: type=credit_conversion, fields: from_tier, to_tier, ratio, original_credits, converted_credits, timestamp, source=billing_job. Keep idempotent billing job.

maya: Edge cases: 
- Customers on legacy SKUs: exclude until mapping table is ready
- One-off manual conversions: via support playbook only (no self-serve first wave)
- International tax treatment: handled by billing team (Carlos)

rachel: Contract amendment template ready, will add a cap clause: "Max converted amount per billing cycle = lesser of 20% of committed monthly credits or 50k Starter credits". Also require a 30-day notice for any change.

carlos: Okay to pilot. Action items: 
- tom: tech design doc by EOD Friday (owner)
- rachel: draft contract clause by Mon
- maya: add acceptance criteria + dashboard metrics by Mon
- jia: sales playbook skeleton by Tue

maya: If no objections, we'll put this in the roadmap as a Q3 pilot (A/B gated) and track revenue + churn impact. :thumbsup:

carlos: +1

jia: +1

maya: Thanks everyone — leaving this thread open for any more edge cases.
